article.title: SmallRig在深圳把創作者交流延伸至總部藝術裝置
article.summary: SmallRig稱與深圳國際藝術博物館合辦交流，聚焦AI如何用於影像創作，並在總部揭幕聯合創作的裝置。
highlights: 藝術家Zadok Ben-David分享用AI探索裝置的鳥形，再篩選及修訂。
論壇後公開與藝術家Feng Yu共同創作的《Ode to the Orchid》。
article.why: 影像品牌可把創作者分享、實物展示與日後產品回饋設成可延續的合作。
article.next_step: 用一個工作坊或展品收集創作流程問題，再交產品團隊逐項回覆。
article.detail: SmallRig披露深圳交流會邀請美術館、策展人和藝術家談影像創作。藝術家Zadok Ben-David分享如何反覆修訂由AI輔助探索的鳥形，再選用部分結果。論壇後，SmallRig在總部揭幕與Feng Yu共同創作的裝置，把這次創作者合作由討論延伸到實物展示。
article.title_en: SmallRig extends a Shenzhen creator forum with an installation at its headquarters
article.summary_en: SmallRig says it co-hosted a discussion on AI and image-making with the Shenzhen International Art Museum, then unveiled a co-created installation at its headquarters.
highlights_en: Artist Zadok Ben-David shared how he explored bird forms with AI before selecting and refining them.
SmallRig unveiled Ode to the Orchid, co-created with artist Feng Yu, after the forum.
article.why_en: Imaging brands can connect creator talks, physical displays and later product feedback into a sustained partnership.
article.next_step_en: Use one workshop or installation to collect workflow questions, then have the product team respond.
article.detail_en: SmallRig said museum leaders, curators and artists discussed image-making at its Shenzhen event. Zadok Ben-David shared how he iterated on AI-assisted explorations of bird forms and selected some for his work. SmallRig later unveiled its installation with Feng Yu at headquarters, extending the collaboration from discussion to a physical display.
